nomenclature.author: Ramamoorthy, Thennilapuram Parasuraman (1976)
nomenclature.etymology:
-
Buchanania
: After Francis Buchanan-Hamilton (1762-1829), surgeon in the East India Company (Bengal Medical Service), naturalist and fellow of the Royal Society and of the Linnean Society.
-
Axillaris
: Arising from the leaf axils, axillary.
nomenclature.etymology_html:
-Buchanania : After Francis Buchanan-Hamilton (1762-1829), surgeon in the East India Company (Bengal Medical Service), naturalist and fellow of the Royal Society and of the Linnean Society.
-Axillaris : Arising from the leaf axils, axillary.

stem_bark.text: The bark of Buchanania axillaris is brown-greyish coloured, rough, longitudinally fissured and transversally cracked.
stem_bark.text_html: The bark of Buchanania axillaris is brown-greyish coloured, rough, longitudinally fissured and transversally cracked.

seed.text: The seed of Buchanania axillaris is ovoid and compressed. It is 1 cm long and 0.8 cm wide. There is only one seed per fruit.
seed.text_html: The seed of Buchanania axillaris is ovoid and compressed. It is 1 cm long and 0.8 cm wide. There is only one seed per fruit.

fruit.text: The fruit of Buchanania axillaris is a 1-seeded drupe . The fruit is globose, green-brownish and about 1.5 cm in diameter.
fruit.text_html: The fruit of Buchanania axillaris is a 1-seeded drupe. The fruit is globose, green-brownish and about 1.5 cm in diameter.

flower.text: The flowers of Buchanania axillaris are grouped in axillary panicles (at the upper axils of the new branchlets). The peduncle is 1.5-2 cm long. The calyx is composed of 5 small and semicircular sepals (1 mm long). The calyx is light green-coloured. The corolla is composed of 5 white-greenish and glabrous petals. The petals are obovate and recurved, 2.5-3 mm long and 1.5 mm wide. The pedicels are very short (about 0.5 mm long). The androecium is composed of 10 stamens. The buds are glabrous, light green, globular and 1.5-2 mm across. The flowers are fragrant.
flower.text_html:
The flowers of Buchanania axillaris are grouped in axillary panicles (at the upper axils of the new branchlets). The peduncle is 1.5-2 cm long.
The calyx is composed of 5 small and semicircular sepals (1 mm long). The calyx is light green-coloured.
The corolla is composed of 5 white-greenish and glabrous petals. The petals are obovate and recurved, 2.5-3 mm long and 1.5 mm wide.
The pedicels are very short (about 0.5 mm long).
The androecium is composed of 10 stamens.
The buds are glabrous, light green, globular and 1.5-2 mm across.
The flowers are fragrant.

leaf.text: The leaves of Buchanania axillaris grow alternately on the stem (spirally arranged). The leaf is simple, bright green coloured above and paler beneath. The leaf is coriaceous and glabrous on both sides. The leaves have a 3-4 cm long petiole . The leaf of Buchanania axillaris is 13-18 cm long and 3-4 cm wide. The shape is oblong-elliptic, the apex is obtuse-emarginate, the base is cuneate-attenuate and the margins are entire. The venation of the leaf is reticulate with a prominent midrib.
leaf.text_html:

The leaf of Buchanania axillaris is 13-18 cm long and 3-4 cm wide. The shape is oblong-elliptic, the apex is obtuse-emarginate, the base is cuneate-attenuate and the margins are entire.
The venation of the leaf is reticulate with a prominent midrib.

habit.text: Buchanania axillaris is a medium-sized and evergreen tree up to 10-12 m.
habit.text_html: Buchanania axillaris is a medium-sized and evergreen tree up to 10-12 m.

ecology.text: Buchanania axillaris is found in deciduous forests from the coastal plains up to 800-1000 m in the hills.
ecology.text_html:
• Ecology :

    Buchanania axillaris is found in deciduous forests from the coastal plains up to 800-1000 m in the hills.

reproduction_dispersal.text: Buchanania axillaris is bisexual (each flower of each individual has both male and female structures). Buchanania axillaris is pollinated by a wide variety of insects. The seeds of Buchanania axillaris are mainly dispersed by frugivorous birds and mammals.
reproduction_dispersal.text_html:
• Sex distribution :

    Buchanania axillaris is bisexual (each flower of each individual has both male and female structures).

  • Mode of pollination :

    Buchanania axillaris is pollinated by a wide variety of insects.

  • Seed dispersal :

    The seeds of Buchanania axillaris are mainly dispersed by frugivorous birds and mammals.

culinary.text: The kernel of the seeds of Buchanania axillaris is edible.
culinary.text_html: The kernel of the seeds of Buchanania axillaris is edible.

medicinal.text: The leaves of Buchanania axillaris are laxative, depurative, cooling, aphrodisiac, cardiotonic, astringent and wound healing. The leaf juice is digestive, expectorant, aphrodisiac and purgative. The seeds are tonic to the body and the brain. The kernel is laxative and febrifuge. ( Quattrocchi, 2012, CRC World Dictionary of Medicinal and Poisonous Plants ) The gum is antidiarrheal and it is used internally in rheumatism. ( Khare, 2007, Indian Medicinal Plants, An Illustrated Dictionary ) The kernels of Buchanania axillaris made into a powder and mixed with milk are used as an aphrodisiac. ( http://www.flowersofindia.net )
medicinal.text_html:
The leaves of Buchanania axillaris are laxative, depurative, cooling, aphrodisiac, cardiotonic, astringent and wound healing.

The leaf juice is digestive, expectorant, aphrodisiac and purgative.

The seeds are tonic to the body and the brain. The kernel is laxative and febrifuge. (Quattrocchi, 2012, CRC World Dictionary of Medicinal and Poisonous Plants)

The gum is antidiarrheal and it is used internally in rheumatism. (Khare, 2007, Indian Medicinal Plants, An Illustrated Dictionary)

The kernels of Buchanania axillaris made into a powder and mixed with milk are used as an aphrodisiac. (http://www.flowersofindia.net)

reforestation.text: Buchanania axillaris is able to grow in a wide range of soils but all soils need to be free draining. This species is drought tolerant and prefers to establish in full sun. Buchanania axillaris is propagated by seeds. 12 hours of soaking in water accelerates the germination process.
reforestation.text_html:
• Planting advice and requirements :

    Buchanania axillaris is able to grow in a wide range of soils but all soils need to be free draining. This species is drought tolerant and prefers to establish in full sun.
    Buchanania axillaris is propagated by seeds.

  • Seed treatments :

    12 hours of soaking in water accelerates the germination process.
